title: Tou no Kemono
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Lukka, an orphan blind in one eye, is shoved by villagers into the path of a carriage, but the passenger, the nobleman Edgar, takes him in to ease his own solitude. Lukka grows into a loyal servant and friend, and each month, while Edgar is away, he feeds the beautiful black wolf kept in the estate's tower. A single-volume gothic shounen-ai tale with werewolf and immortality themes.
life_message: Kindness to an outcast and loyal companionship can heal two lonely lives.
